mapper.select: SELECT A.ACNO AS "acno" /* 계좌번호 */ , A.CUST_NO AS "custNo" /* 고객번호 */ , C.CUST_NM AS "custNm" /* 고객명 */ , A.PDCD AS "pdcd" /* 상품코드 */ , A.PRCP_AMT AS "prcpAmt" /* 원금 */ , A.OPN_DT AS "opnDt" /* 개설일자 */ , A.MTRT_DT AS "mtrtDt" /* 만기일자 */ , A.ACNT_STCD AS "acntStcd" /* 계좌상태코드 */ , R.BSRT AS "bsrt" , R.PRFT_RT AS "prftRt" FROM TB_DPST_ACNT A JOIN TB_CUST C ON C.CUST_NO = A.CUST_NO JOIN TB_INTR_RATE R ON R.PDCD = A.PDCD AND R.APLY_DT = A.OPN_DT WHERE A.ACNO = #{acno}

SELECT ROUND(A.PRCP_AMT * CASE WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(#{cnclDt},'YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE(A.OPN_DT,'YYYYMMDD'))) < 1 THEN 0.1 WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(#{cnclDt},'YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE(A.OPN_DT,'YYYYMMDD'))) < 3 THEN R.BSRT * 0.3 WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(#{cnclDt},'YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE(A.OPN_DT,'YYYYMMDD'))) < 6 THEN R.BSRT * 0.5 WHEN A.OPN_DT < '20150101' THEN R.BSRT * 0.5 WHEN TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(TO_DATE(#{cnclDt},'YYYYMMDD'), TO_DATE(A.OPN_DT,'YYYYMMDD'))) < 12 THEN R.BSRT * 0.6 ELSE R.BSRT * 0.7 END / 100 * (TO_DATE(#{cnclDt},'YYYYMMDD') - TO_DATE(A.OPN_DT,'YYYYMMDD')) / 365, 0) AS EXPECT_INTR FROM TB_DPST_ACNT A JOIN TB_INTR_RATE R ON R.PDCD = A.PDCD AND R.APLY_DT = A.OPN_DT WHERE A.ACNO = #{acno}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DPST_CLOSE_HIST (ACNO, CNCL_DT, INTR_AMT, TAX_AMT, REG_DTM) VALUES (#{acno}, #{cnclDt}, #{intrAmt}, #{taxAmt}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT ACNO AS "acno" , MTRT_DT AS "mtrtDt" , ACNT_STCD AS "acntStcd" FROM TB_DPST_ACNT
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DPST_ACNT SET ACNT_STCD = '5' WHERE ACNT_STCD = '9' AND CNCL_DT < #{baseDt}
